newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CSN to finalize consortium next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CSN to finalize consortium next week.

text.p: Brazilian steelmaker CSN is expected to finalize at the beginning of next week a consortium which will bid in the privatization auction of state mining giant CVRD, a company spokesman said.
CSN is one of two Brazilian companies trying to form a consortium that will participate in the April 29 auction of a 45 percent voting stake in CVRD.

Metal, cement and pulp group Votorantim is also assembling a consortium which is likely to include South Africa's Anglo American Corp, Banco Safra and 12 Japanese steel and trading companies led by Nippon Steel Corp.
"By the beginning of next week, we will have closed a deal on forming a consortium," said CSN spokesman Francisco Padilha."We are still talking to everyone, but negotiations are coming to an end."

Padilha said CSN was in talks with South Africa's Gencor, pulp and paper firm Cia Suzano, metal and metallurgical company Caemi, NationsBank and Opportunity Asset Management, as well as a group of seven pension funds.
The pension funds are coveted players in the race to set up a consortium because they already own 15 percent of CVRD voting stock and 18 percent of total capital.
The new owners of the 45 percent CVRD voting block will be in a controlling position if they have the pension funds on their side.
Padilha said the pension funds were expected to decide by Monday which of the two consortia they would join.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
